profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | HTML, CSS, Javascript, React, Storybook, Design Systems | Passionate about building UI Components
profile.summary:
I live my life in a cross-section of design and engineering. I thrive on bridging the gap between those two worlds and actively seek engagement in both. I am passionate about user interactions with technology and how it makes them feel in their day-to-day lives. A design should never distract or detract, only enable better experiences.

---SKILLS---
Frameworks: React, Angular2+, AngularJs
Design: Storybook, CSS, SCSS, Sketch, Figma, Responsive Design, UI/UX
Back-end: REST/JSON APIs
Workflow: Git, Bitbucket
Other: HTML5, SEO optimizations, WAI-ARIA

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Design Systems
Front-End Developer
positions.description:
• Created a framework-agnostic and React specific component library that allows multiple products to share a unified UI/UX for easier maintainability
• Led development and management of a team of 3-5 engineers building brand new applications while building a component library in parallel
• Sole front-end developer on an entire backend/full-stack team focusing on refactoring a large CSS codebase with a focus BEM, and front-end best practices
• Collaborate with founders, UI/UX team, and stakeholders on product creation
• Technologies used: HTML, CSS/SCSS, BEM, AngularJS, React, Storybook

positions.description:

• Refactor large SCSS codebases with a focus BEM, SMACSS best practices
• Build, maintain, and support several products with attention to detail on performance, maintainability, and readability
• Collaborate with product managers to solve complex problems
• Technologies used: AngularJS, Angular 2+, Javascript, HTML, SCSS, NPM, Git, Grunt

positions.title: Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborate closely with internal teams, stakeholders, and campaign managers to provide updates with constant communication to ensure we create and launch microsites that benefit client goals
• Translate wireframes & photoshop comps into standards-based, cross-browser HTML & CSS
• Build, support, maintain, and fix bugs on our five corporate radio station websites, landing pages, email templates, and other assets
• Always advocate for the end-user and seek to deliver quality online experiences
• DFP for Traffickers Certified

projects.title: Lego CSS Storybook
projects.description: When I first learned to program, I used the CSS libraries like Bootstrap and Material Design. They made creating websites painless, easy, and fast. The downside was the considerable amount of code bloat that came along with those libraries that I would never use. The amount of time I spent overriding specific styles to my liking always felt like a waste. When I noticed I was doing this for every project, the LegoCSS project was born.

projects.title: Artist Website
projects.description: Utilizing my opportunity to take a free online class as a full time employee at Academy of Art University, I created my first artist website in Summer of 2014. Coded from scratch using HTML and CSS, the production of the site continues to be an ongoing project as I expand upon my web design skills.
